name: RepoIntelligenceAgent
description: Deterministically indexes every fetched source language into a knowledge graph (routes, handlers, pages, forms, API calls, agents, prompts, config, tests, dependencies) plus code chunks, with coverage (indexed by language, skipped by reason); cached per commit in Postgres (not cached without a commit SHA).

inputs.name: repo_tree
inputs.description: Full file list of the branch

outputs.name: snapshot_id
outputs.description: RepoSnapshot id actually used (null when not cached: no SHA or no database)

outputs.name: repo_graph
outputs.description: In-memory knowledge graph for this run

outputs.name: repo_model
outputs.description: Counts, routes, pages, models, env vars, build plan, risk signals and coverage (files_indexed, by_language, skipped, unfetched/unindexed source)
